'''''Red Nebula''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that served as the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sinasu kept the vessel docked at the little-used freight pad [[Spaceport 27]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
